title: pretty OLIVE|Off Shoulder Short Sleeve Split Back-Tie Satin Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
Elevate your special occasion in our Off Shoulder Short Sleeve Split Back-Tie Satin Bridesmaid Dresses! This stunning gown features a flattering off-the-shoulder design that highlights your neckline and shoulders, while the short sleeves add a touch of elegance. Crafted from premium bandage fabric, it hugs your curves in all the right places, creating a show-stopping silhouette. The daring split adds a playful hint of allure, making every step you take a head-turner. Perfect for weddings, formal events, or any celebration where you want to shine, this dress is your go-to choice for timeless beauty and sophistication.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves


Closure: Bandage - side zipper


Undergarments: It is padded enough for "no bra" option, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises satin


Stretch: Fabric is low stretch
